title: An unsuccessful attempt to remove a judge
body: In 1991 the first-ever motion to remove a judge of the Supreme Court was signed by 108 members of Parliament. The judge concerned was accused of misappropriating funds while he was serving as the Chief Justice of a High Court. In 1992 an inquiry commission consisting of judges of the Supreme Court found him guilty of wilful and gross misuse of office and of using public funds for private purposes. When the motion recommending his removal was put to vote in the Lok Sabha, it received the support of more than two-thirds of the members present and voting. However, a large party abstained from voting, so the motion did not receive the support of more than one-half of the total strength of the House. As a result, the judge was not removed from office.
